name: The Alabaster Wardens
summary: The elite militia tasked with protecting Brightend and enforcing the law. The most prestigious branch of Eperinian Wardens.
quote: "Order is not a natural state. It must be enforced."
assets: 500+ heavily armored guards across the country
directives: Investigate the surge of crimes in the recent days
Reinforce protections in the Cloud District
rumors: Some Wardens are actually mole people plotting to seize the kingdom
Foll was King Teal's secret lover

intel.title: Official Mandate
intel.content: "The bearers of this writ are operating under the partial jurisdiction of Grand Warden Foll. Provide them necessary access to the Cloud District crime scenes."

intel.name: Grand Warden Foll
intel.description: Stern, unyielding leader of the city guard. Currently dealing with internal corruption and erased witnesses.
